notes.title: New Price Change
notes.content:
Hello,

Franky put, Lonely Tribes doesn't make much money at all, and due to the way that Steam's finances operate, it's unlikely I'll ever see a penny. Therefore, I may as well go Free to Play. 

If I come back to Lonely Tribes, this might change and I'll get out of EA, but for now I'll formally declare Lonely Tribes on extended Hiatus.

Thanks,

Jack

notes.title: Patch 0.2.2
notes.content:
Turns out that, in my code to work out whether I had your screen res, it was comparing the most common DPI to the default DPI to see if I had it.
Changed so that it also requires the default (rare), resolution to make a new res.
